WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_base
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
), state_shares AS (
  SELECT state_county_province, account_base,
         1.0 * account_base / SUM(account_base) OVER () AS share
  FROM state_counts
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM state_shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.account_base) AS combined_account_base,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_over_average_share
FROM state_shares s
CROSS JOIN average_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
